reasoning_content: Let's wait for the app to come up and verify the observability readiness and feature flags, and test the actual dev-auth flow.

action.command:
cd /workspace && for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "live up after ~$((i*5))s"; break; }
  sleep 5
done
echo "=== verify current dev-auth user flow ==="
echo "--- /auth/login (expect 302 to /?auth=dev-login) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - http://localhost:3000/auth/login | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location)'
echo "--- POST /auth/dev-login with CSRF header + cookie ---"
rm -f /tmp/cj.txt
curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/dl.txt -w 'dev-login HTTP %{http_code}\n' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:3000/' -X POST http://localhost:3000/auth/dev-login
head -c 200 /tmp/dl.txt; echo
echo "--- /auth/me WITH dev-auth session cookie ---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -w '\nme HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/auth/me | head -c 700; echo
